name: Crag Linnorm
savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Cold Iron)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Curse of Fire
defensiveAbilities.description:
When a creature slays the crag linnorm, it must succeed at a DC 35 Will Saving Throw save or gain weakness to fire 15 with an unlimited duration.

Effect: Curse of Fire

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike (Tail Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(2d6+14) Bludgeoning Damage, Basic DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crag Linnorm Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw;

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 4d6 Fire Damage damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 Fire Damage damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Magma Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
The crag linnorm breathes out a stream of magma in a 120ft Line that deals 12d6 Fire Damage damage to creatures within the area (Basic DC 34 Reflex Saving Throw save). Any creature that fails its save also takes 4d6 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

The linnorm can't use Magma Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

The magma remains until the start of the linnorm's next turn. If the linnorm was on the ground, the magma remains as a burning line on the ground directly under the line of the Magma Breath; if the linnorm was airborne, the magma rains down in a sheet 60 feet high. Any creature that moves across or through the magma takes 6d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 34 Reflex Saving Throw save).

At the start of the linnorm's next turn, the magma cools to a thin layer of brittle stone, or the magma rain finishes falling and turns to harmless pebbles. The cooled magma quickly degrades to powder and sand over the course of several hours.

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Improved Grab as an action and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Improved Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

lv6spells.name: Unfettered Movement (Constant)
lv6spells.description: You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to Escape an effect that has them Immobilized, Grabbed, or Restrained, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.

lv6spells.name: Truesight (Constant)
lv6spells.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).
